text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Mozambican government, trade union leaders and cashew industrialists will hold a national seminar this week to discuss the country's cashew nut problems. Under pressure from the World Bank, the government slashed measures protecting the local processing industry, which now complains of a shortage of raw material because the nuts are being exported to India unshelled.
- Four Mozambicans trying to enter South Africa illegally in the last week were eaten by lions in the Kruger National Park.
